Pfizer's average quarterly net income over fiscal 2025 was roughly $1.94 billion, based on full-year net income attributable to Pfizer of about $7.77 billion divided by four. This is from memory rather than a filing in front of me, so treat it as a best estimate.

My recollection of the quarterly figures behind the full-year total:

| Quarter | Net income attributable to Pfizer (USD billions) |
|---|---|
| Q1 2025 | 2.967 |
| Q2 2025 | 2.910 |
| Q3 2025 | 3.541 |
| Q4 2025 | (1.648) |
| Full year | 7.770 |

Average: 7.770 / 4 ≈ 1.94 billion.

Net income including noncontrolling interests would be slightly higher (around $7.8 billion for the year), which would not change the average materially.
